bio: Two decades in solid-phase peptide synthesis, spanning research-grade batches, difficult sequences, and multi-kilogram process scale-up. Leads the synthesis platform team and signs off on feasibility reviews for complex projects.
Runs the characterization laboratory — high-resolution HPLC, LC-MS/MS, and mass spectrometry — and manages the method validation program behind every Certificate of Analysis the company issues.
Oversees clean-room production, lyophilization and filling operations, batch record review, and the quality management system that governs release of every manufactured batch.
Builds joint R&D programs and OEM relationships with universities, biotech companies, and distributors across 50+ countries, supported by a multilingual account team.
